idea-plugin.name: DevTomcat
idea-plugin.description:
DevTomcat - Professional Tomcat Integration for IntelliJ Community Edition

Brings IntelliJ Ultimate's complete Tomcat functionality to Community Edition!

Professional Features:

  • 5-Tab Configuration Interface - Server, Deployment, Logs, Startup/Connection, Code Coverage
  • Professional Server Management - Complete application server configuration with JMX support
  • Advanced Deployment Control - Artifact management with hot deployment and update classes/resources
  • Multi-Log Monitoring - Separate console tabs for Catalina, Localhost, Access, and custom logs
  • Environment & Script Management - Professional environment variables and startup/shutdown scripts
  • Enterprise Code Coverage - JaCoCo, Emma, Cobertura, and IntelliJ coverage engines

Enhanced Development Experience:

  • Real-Time Deployment Status - Professional deployment messages with progress indicators
  • Intelligent Log Parsing - Smart detection of deployment events, errors, and performance metrics
  • Hot Deployment Support - Update classes and resources without server restart
  • JMX Integration - Remote monitoring and management capabilities
  • Smart Project Detection - Auto-configuration for Spring Boot, Maven, Gradle projects
  • Development Mode Optimizations - Faster development workflows with enhanced debugging

Perfect For:

  • JSP and Servlet development
  • Spring Boot web applications
  • Enterprise Java projects
  • Maven and Gradle multi-module projects
  • Professional Java web development

Experience professional Tomcat development with enhanced functionality!
